why.availabilityText: Each room's calendar updates the moment someone books. If a room shows as free, you can book it.
why.cancelText_one: A paid booking can be cancelled for free, with a refund, until {{count}} day before check-in. Unpaid bookings can be cancelled at any time.
why.cancelText_other: A paid booking can be cancelled for free, with a refund, until {{count}} days before check-in. Unpaid bookings can be cancelled at any time.
why.cancelTextGeneric: Cancellation and refund rules are shown before you confirm a booking.
why.paymentText: Pay through the payment gateway right after booking, or later while your room is held.
